**Tycoon Lake** is a location in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Burning Springs* update.

- Mission Stomper - Note, underneath the collapsed dock .
- Summers gone by - Note, on a Picnic Table next to the shack.
- Note to Manny - Note, on a green Pick-R-Up Truck at a pump station west of the lake.
- Four Abraxodyne Intel:
 - One in the shed at the pump station.
 - One on the green Pick-R-Up Truck, same one that has Note to Manny.
 - One inside a camper north of the lake.
 - One is up the dirt road leaning against a wooden log next to a motorcycle, northeast of the lake.

Tycoon Lake appears in *Fallout 76*.
